### Expro Ltd Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/960448380/files/doc_news/Expro-Ltd-Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Expro Ltd (NYSE: XPRO) (“Expro” or the “Company”) will hold a conference call on November 3, 2026 to discuss results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The conference call is scheduled to begin at 10:00 a.m. Central Time (11:00 a.m. Eastern Time). A press release regarding the results will be issued before the market opens on November 3rd, and the press release, together with associated presentation slides, will be posted to the investor relations section of the Expro website in advance of the conference call.


We encourage those who plan to dial-in to the conference to pre-register: ****[Pre-Registration Link.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F591846746&esheet=54627015&newsitemid=20261022370622&lan=en-US&anchor=Pre-Registration+Link.&index=1&md5=047fb22ae9df6cecf4489706f9280710) **** Callers who pre-register will be given a dial-in number and unique PIN via email to gain immediate access to the call.


Participants may also join the conference call by dialing:
Toll-Free: +1 833 461-5787
Toll: +1 626 884-3620
Access code: **591846746**


To listen via live webcast, please visit the investor section of[https://www.expro.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.expro.com%2F&esheet=54627015&newsitemid=20261022370622&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.expro.com%2F&index=2&md5=e261b65557aa157063ec727010b1576d) .


An audio replay of the webcast will be available in the Investor section of the Company’s website approximately 3 hours after the conclusion of the call and remain available for a period of two weeks.


To access the audio replay telephonically:
U.S. (Toll-Free) +1 833 309-1852
U.S. (Local) +1 929 828-5978
Access ID: **591846746** Start Date: November 3, 2026, 1:00 p.m. CT
End Date: November 17, 2026, 10:59 p.m. CT


**ABOUT EXPRO**


Working for clients across the entire well life cycle, Expro is a leading provider of energy services, offering cost-effective, innovative solutions and what the Company considers to be best-in-class safety and service quality. The Company’s extensive portfolio of capabilities spans well construction, well flow management, subsea well access and well intervention and integrity solutions.


With roots dating to 1938, Expro has approximately 7,000 employees and provides services and solutions to leading exploration and production companies in both onshore and offshore environments in more than 60 countries.


For more information, please visit:[expro.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.expro.com%2F&esheet=54627015&newsitemid=20261022370622&lan=en-US&anchor=expro.com&index=3&md5=16d521dba65f71d8b3dfee9362b09bb4) and connect with Expro on X (formerly Twitter):[@ExproGroup](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FExproGroup%3Fref_src%3Dtwsrc%255Egoogle%257Ctwcamp%255Eserp%257Ctwgr%255Eauthor&esheet=54627015&newsitemid=20261022370622&lan=en-US&anchor=%40ExproGroup&index=4&md5=1e074fbc91427db38da3c9bc1a687562) and LinkedIn:[@Expro](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fexpro&esheet=54627015&newsitemid=20261022370622&lan=en-US&anchor=%40Expro&index=5&md5=d8baa06b537ee529192b6e4c797d8cf5) .
